declared.title: Session-wide input budget refuses with typed backpressure before it is exceeded

failure.hint: compare expected and actual values in the evidence

stdout.text: <ready and report lines are parsed, not stored: the ready line carries the bearer>

cases.summary: Five programs that never read their PTYs each take 3 MiB writes in turn, every terminal staying under its 16 MiB input queue. hello advertises session_input_bytes 67108864: the first 21 writes (63 MiB) are admitted and the 22nd, which would take the session to 66 MiB, must be refused with typed backpressure before the budget is exceeded.
